paper_xml.coverage: article metadata, Table 1 peptide/activity rows, results, methods, figure captions, and mechanism context

paper_pdf.coverage: PDF text cross-check for Table 1, biofilm results, cytotoxicity results, and methods

oa_package.coverage: PMC package NXML, PDF, and figure images including Fig. 2/Fig. 3/Fig. 4

supplementary_assets.coverage: Landing-page HTML assets only; no structured supplement table recoverable or needed.

merged_database_rows.coverage: DBAASP assay/literature rows and CAMP/dbAMP aggregate text rows reconciled against primary source evidence.

per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_2_activity_toxicity: Primary Table 1 was converted into MIC/MBC/T3log rows for all 11 peptides/lipopeptides, and source-supported biofilm/cytotoxicity values from prose/Fig. 4 were added. Database-only rows were not promoted to primary rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_4_database: All linked assay, experiment, and literature rows were reopened. 24 rows are source_verified and 48 rows remain conflict-preserved due to missing N-acyl modification identity, database MBEC terminology, or aggregate database text.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_mechanism: Mechanism output is limited to functional killing and imaging/penetration context; no direct molecular mechanism is asserted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: The original blocking ticket is closed after source-reviewed repair. Final status is accepted_with_cautions because conflict-preserved database rows and figure-only non-digitized values remain visible as cautions, not blocking rework.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Several DBAASP rows share an unmodified sequence string while primary Table 1 distinguishes N-acylated derivatives by name/modification. Those rows remain source_conflict when modification identity is not explicit in the database row.

Linked database rows use MBEC/MBEC50 labels, but the primary paper reports antibiofilm MTT/CV, viable-count, and CLSM outcomes rather than a defined MBEC endpoint. Source-supported biofilm outcomes are preserved separately.
CAMP/dbAMP entry-text rows aggregate multiple papers, organisms, and values. Local PAO1 values are preserved where source-supported; unsupported aggregate text is not promoted to primary evidence.

Figure 4 exact percent labels were captured. Figure 2/3 unlabeled bar heights were inspected but not digitized; the final rows use source text, Table 1, and image labels rather than estimated bar heights.
The landed supplementary *.bin files are HTML landing pages and the PMC article metadata says no supplement; no structured supplementary table changes activity, database, or mechanism adjudication.
The source supports functional killing and imaging/penetration context, but not a direct molecular mechanism. Final mechanism claims avoid direct_mechanism overclaiming.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Figure 2 and Figure 3 are bar graphs without embedded numeric data labels for every bar. Exact bar heights would require estimation/digitization, so only text-supported inequalities and figure-label values are asserted.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: No exact graph-only bar values were fabricated; Table 1, source text, and Fig. 4 label values cover the final activity/toxicity claims used for acceptance.

adjudication_summary: Fresh worker-2/4/6 re-review reopened the handoff packet, primary XML/PDF, OA package figures, supplementary landing assets, and linked database rows. Table 1 and source-supported biofilm/cytotoxicity evidence are now captured, database conflicts are preserved with row context, mechanism claims are bounded, and the paper is publication-grade accepted_with_cautions after gate rerun.
